mintAuthority.summary: sYUSD is Aegis's yield-bearing ERC-4626 wrapper over chain-local YUSD on Ethereum and BSC. Each local wrapper mints shares only through YUSD-backed deposit/mint accounting; its transparent-proxy replacement path is controlled by a chain-local ProxyAdmin owned by the same 3-of-5 Safe. Durable YUSD issuance is inherited from the reviewed Ethereum and BSC AegisMinting controls, while the parent's LayerZero bridge remains outside this profile.

Safe getOwners()=5 owners, getThreshold()=3. masterCopy=0x41675c (v1.4.1). getModulesPaginated sentinel only (no modules). Guard keccak slot=0x0. This is the Ethereum sYUSD wrapper's native upgrade authority; the separately observed BSC ProxyAdmin/Safe path is authored below.

controls.label: Aegis sYUSD BSC ERC-4626 wrapper share accounting
controls.capDescription: The BSC sYUSD wrapper mints shares through ERC-4626 deposit/mint flows against YUSD asset 0xab3dbcd9b096c3ff76275038bf58eac10d22c61f and burns shares during withdrawal/cooldown; this local share accounting cannot create base YUSD supply. ADMIN_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls pause, cooldown, and rescue settings but does not bypass the deposit-bound accounting in the reviewed implementation.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116365876, the proxy returned name() = Staked YUSD, symbol() = sYUSD, 18 decimals, asset() = 0xab3dbcd9b096c3ff76275038bf58eac10d22c61f, implementation 0x42940c329e2a4d0bd0e828b7815c90111065415e, and EIP-1967 admin 0x87696e700eb66a4c807731f68ad33d9dba2036a8. The verified contracts/sYUSD.sol implementation mints shares through local ERC-4626 deposit/mint flows only after the wrapper receives YUSD and burns shares during withdrawal/cooldown. Its ADMIN_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE controls pause, cooldown, and rescue surfaces, but no arbitrary or cross-chain mint function is exposed.

controls.label: Aegis sYUSD BSC ProxyAdmin owner Safe (3-of-5)
controls.capDescription: Transparent BSC sYUSD proxy; EIP-1967 admin slot = ProxyAdmin 0x87696e700eb66a4c807731f68ad33d9dba2036a8; ProxyAdmin owner() = Safe 0x4fe78ef65bd8edded480efab030ba680646503c8 (3/5). The Safe also holds the BSC wrapper's ADMIN_ROLE, so it can replace local share-mint logic and administer pause, cooldown, and rescue settings; this is native wrapper administration, not bridge control.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116365876, sYUSD proxy 0x24db057b19241eefb9b522e8627c293ed8f93af2 returned implementation 0x42940c329e2a4d0bd0e828b7815c90111065415e and EIP-1967 admin 0x87696e700eb66a4c807731f68ad33d9dba2036a8; ProxyAdmin owner() returned Safe 0x4fe78ef65bd8edded480efab030ba680646503c8. The Safe read confirmed threshold 3, five owners, no module evidence, and zero guard. The BSC wrapper ADMIN_ROLE is held by this Safe, which can replace the implementation and alter local share accounting, but no bridge capability is evidenced.

controls.label: Inherited AegisMinting
controls.evidence: Inherited from reviewed yusd-aegis mintAuthority. Ethereum sYUSD's durable YUSD exposure follows the Ethereum AegisMinting path at 0xC4Df68e592245cA5202fE8b7C438d2b799820fc2; the separate BSC AegisMinting path is authored below.

controls.label: Inherited AegisMinting (BSC)
controls.capDescription: No permanent on-chain supply ceiling; BSC AegisMinting is the sole minter of BSC YUSD and its configurable mint limits are administered by the common Aegis admin Safe.
controls.evidence: Inherited from reviewed yusd-aegis mintAuthority. At BSC block 116345704, YUSD 0xab3dbcd9b096c3ff76275038bf58eac10d22c61f.minter() = AegisMinting 0x02bf8f0e046F471709E578b1E633077096ce65CF, and AegisMinting.owner()/defaultAdmin() and AegisConfig.owner() returned the common Aegis admin Safe 0x4Fe78eF65BD8EDDED480efaB030BA680646503c8. BSC AegisConfig 0xB9f1E8417ABaedF6Fd838212267cA8260c4ca9da trustedSigner() returned 0xb28c97E348C3078fC1F6Fcc61b79c8a0DA35008e; the native mint(Order,signature) path requires that single signer plus the collateral/order checks. The 600-second, 210,000e18 BSC mint limit is configurable and raiseable, not a permanent supply ceiling. This is inherited native YUSD issuance for the BSC sYUSD wrapper, not a bridge route.

review.evidence: Mint Authority review refreshed 2026-08-16. At Ethereum block 25771120, sYUSD proxy 0xfe0ccc9942e98c963fe6b4e5194eb6e3baa4cb64 returned asset() = YUSD 0x4274cd7277c7bb0806bd5fe84b9adae466a8da0a, implementation 0xb0c63bb1667b6e9215aee562af2957739b2676fe, and ProxyAdmin 0x5b35fca1874083000a6ef64ff27c891f311282a9. At BSC block 116365876, proxy 0x24db057b19241eefb9b522e8627c293ed8f93af2 returned asset() = YUSD 0xab3dbcd9b096c3ff76275038bf58eac10d22c61f, implementation 0x42940c329e2a4d0bd0e828b7815c90111065415e, and ProxyAdmin 0x87696e700eb66a4c807731f68ad33d9dba2036a8. Both are local ERC-4626 wrappers: verified deposit/mint flows transfer chain-local YUSD before minting shares, and withdrawal/cooldown burns shares; the BSC ADMIN_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE surface controls pause, cooldown, and rescue but cannot bypass asset accounting in the reviewed implementation. Each ProxyAdmin is owned by the same Aegis 3-of-5 Safe with five owners, no module evidence, and a zero guard. Durable YUSD issuance is inherited from the reviewed Ethereum and BSC AegisMinting controls; the BSC path requires the single AegisConfig trusted signer and collateral/order checks, and its configurable 600-second, 210,000e18 mint limit is raiseable. Accountable signed reserve proofs support periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision. No sYUSD contract exposes LayerZero/OFT, peer, endpoint, lockbox, validator/DVN, cross-chain mint/burn, or rate-limit machinery; the parent YUSD bridge remains under yusd-aegis Bridge Risk.
